readerCopy.body: The choice that keeps everyone comfortable may be the exact choice that keeps your own preference out of the plan. When Lilith squares the North Node, a family expectation, workplace norm, or version of respectability can keep demanding that you soften the decision until it no longer reflects what you wanted. Defiance alone will not build a better setup. Name the specific term you can no longer accept, and decide what you are prepared to walk away from if the other side will not move with you.
